# Vendored third-party code

Generated by `npm run vendor` (scripts/vendor.mjs) from the pinned devDependencies in package.json.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `preact-htm.mjs` | [preact](https://github.com/preactjs/preact) 10.x + `preact/hooks`, [htm](https://github.com/developit/htm) 3.x | MIT |
| `mediabunny.min.mjs` | [mediabunny](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny) | MPL-2.0 (source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny) |
| `mediabunny-aac-encoder.mjs` | [@mediabunny/aac-encoder](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/main/packages/aac-encoder) | MPL-2.0 (modified, see below) |
| `aac-encoder-worker.js` | worker of @mediabunny/aac-encoder, embedding [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)'s AAC encoder (libavcodec) compiled to WebAssembly | MPL-2.0 (wrapper) + LGPL-2.1-or-later (FFmpeg) |

MPL-2.0 applies file-by-file: the Mediabunny bundle is distributed unmodified; its source is available at the link above.

`mediabunny-aac-encoder.mjs` is the package's `dist/bundles/mediabunny-aac-encoder.min.mjs` with three mechanical changes made by
scripts/vendor.mjs so it runs under the MV3 extension CSP: the inlined worker source is moved verbatim into
`aac-encoder-worker.js` and started with `new Worker(new URL('./aac-encoder-worker.js', import.meta.url))` instead of a
`blob:` URL; `import "mediabunny"` points at `./mediabunny.min.mjs`; the Node-only `worker_threads` fallback is replaced by a
rejected promise. These modified files remain under MPL-2.0; the unmodified source is available at the link above.
The FFmpeg code inside `aac-encoder-worker.js` is licensed under the LGPL-2.1-or-later; its source is available from
https://ffmpeg.org/ and the build recipe from the Mediabunny repository (`packages/aac-encoder`). It is loaded as a separate
file, so it can be replaced by a user-built version. The exporter only loads it when the browser has no native AAC encoder.
